scope: MiTeC SQLite Query and Structured Storage Viewer local package regression
coverage: SQLite Query stages only the three selected inert members and restores owned files
SSView stages only SSView.exe; codec, source, sample and unrelated members are excluded
repeat/remove/snapshot restore and user-data preservation with inert fixtures
licenseDisposition: Both exact-version markers are NeedsReview/Unassigned in the local review store. They do not block package planning or migration and do not assert entitlement.

acceptance: Local package lifecycle only. SQLite provenance/database behavior and SSView structured-storage behavior, activation and Windows target acceptance remain pending.
